evidence.mechanism: shot-02s: four nodes (ochre, amber, rust, graphite) wired by hyphae to a grey central web with streams running outward; shot-08s: rust node glows but streams stay one-directional; shot-20s: mirrored to six nodes with no clear reversal.
evidence.ambition: shot-02s: flat 2D line-and-glow scene with one rendering idea; shot-08s: thicker hyphae and soft shadow glows on two nodes; shot-20s: radial mirror doubles the network. Uses about a third of the 24 KB budget.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: cream ground and soft radial glows match the brief palette, but hyphae are jagged aliased polylines and dots read as line dashes; shot-20s: upper 40 percent of the frame is empty and the caption is small bottom-left.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: fungal hyphae on cream ground reads unlike the anchors' contour, weave, flock or reaction-diffusion dish; shot-20s: mirrored network stays a generic line diagram and no Gray-Scott spot texture appears.
evidence.polish: shot-02s: nodes sit in the lower third with the upper half empty; shot-08s: hard cut to a closer frame with nodes repositioned; shot-20s: mirrored composition resolves but never settles into a distinct steady-state pattern.

pairwise_justification: No median archive yet, so there is no prior piece to compare against; tonight wins by default.

critique.change: Make the shade reversal readable: at shot-08s the rust node's hyphae must visibly flip direction, with dots moving toward the shaded node and its stream reversed in colour or speed so the cut is legible.
Fill the empty upper half in shot-02s and shot-20s: raise the central web and seed a visible Gray-Scott spot pattern along the hyphae, the technique the brief names but shot-20s does not show.
Replace the jagged aliased hyphae and dash-like dots with smooth anti-aliased polylines and round dots, and drop the small caption from the bottom-left corner.
